usage: agentware remediate [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                           [--findings-file FINDINGS_FILE]
                           [--diff-range DIFF_RANGE] [--diff-file DIFF_FILE]
                           [--acceptance-file ACCEPTANCE_FILE]
                           [--no-gate-chain]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --findings-file FINDINGS_FILE
                        JSON of confirmed findings (the `review --adversarial`
                        output, or a bare findings array); '-' or omitted
                        reads stdin
  --diff-range DIFF_RANGE
                        git range the fix is applied against (echoed as
                        new_diff_range for the task-5 re-audit)
  --diff-file DIFF_FILE
                        read the unified diff from a file instead of git
  --acceptance-file ACCEPTANCE_FILE
                        path to the feature plan.md acceptance criteria the
                        fixer honors
  --no-gate-chain       skip the post-fix gate-chain re-run (the task-5 re-
                        audit still runs); used by hermetic tests
